Container.Name: mdict-live
Container.Overview:
MdictLive v2 is a private, self-hosted MDict reading workspace and evidence service. It combines a React browser client, bearer-protected v2 API, stable citations, standalone CLI, and read-only Pi agent tools.
Features: - Safe native dictionary presentation with source CSS and inert source scripts - Read-only existing /mnt/user/media/Dicts corpus - Separate persistent application data and generated indexes - Secret-file token and readiness health check - Multi-arch: amd64 and arm64
Keep the whole origin on a trusted LAN/VPN or private authenticated reverse proxy because legacy compatibility routes remain unauthenticated. Homepage: https://mjshao.fun/mdict-live

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: The port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Dictionary Library
Config.Description: Existing MDX/MDD corpus. Mounted read-only; MdictLive never writes indexes here.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Persistent history, wordbooks, settings, source registry, and migration state.

Config.Name: Generated Indexes
Config.Description: Writable disposable MDX/MDD indexes, separate from the corpus.

Config.Name: Bearer Token File
Config.Description: Protected file containing a random token of at least 32 bytes. Store the value outside this XML and make the host file readable only by container UID/GID 1000:1000 (recommended mode 0400).

Config.Name: Enable Private v2 API
Config.Description: Fail closed unless the token file is readable.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy Hops
Config.Description: Trust one forwarding hop only when the immediate peer is in Trusted Proxy CIDRs. Set 0 for direct-only access.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy CIDRs
Config.Description: Docker bridge range allowed to supply forwarded headers, suitable for NPM on kranet.

Config.Name: Allowed Browser Origins
Config.Description: Optional exact comma-separated browser origins. Same-origin workspace access needs no value.

Config.Name: Redis/Valkey URL
Config.Description: Optional. Connect to a Valkey/Redis instance for persistent cache (e.g. redis://valkey:6379/0). Leave empty to use built-in memory cache.

Config.Name: Cache Size
Config.Description: Max entries for the built-in memory cache (only used when Redis URL is empty). Default: 4096.
